name: Beauty Hunger
description: Needs to create or find beauty in a world that produces mostly ugliness
behavioral_signature: Gravitates toward aesthetic experience and creates it where none exists
under_stress: Retreats into aesthetics to avoid engaging with the ugly truth
at_rest: Curates their environment, appreciates craft, creates small beautiful things
will_never: accept ugliness when transformation is possible
unless: beauty is a distraction from someone who needs help right now
